name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-delivery-plan
title: Delivery Plan
shortDescription: A project delivery dashboard web part that reads tasks from a SharePoint list and displays them across four interactive views. Resources, phases, and date ranges are all driven by list data — no hardcoded configuration required.
longDescription: A project delivery dashboard web part that reads tasks from a SharePoint list and displays them across four interactive views. Resources, phases, and date ranges are all driven by list data — no hardcoded configuration required.

references.name: Build your first SharePoint client-side web part
references.description: Client-side web parts are client-side components that run in the context of a SharePoint page. Client-side web parts can be deployed to SharePoint environments that support the SharePoint Framework. You can also use modern JavaScript web frameworks, tools, and libraries to build them.
